EDWARD.content: I saw on Victor's notebook that Victor was not satisfied with you in the company. Why did you lie?

(nervously) Ah, that notebook... I, uh, I didn't know Victor had written that. (pauses) To be honest, I had a bit of a disagreement with Victor about my performance. He was being quite... harsh, I thought. But I didn't think it was a big deal. I mean, it's not uncommon for managers to have high expectations. (clears throat) I didn't think it was a reason to, you know, take drastic measures. (pauses again) But, I suppose, in hindsight, it might seem like a motive for... (stops, choosing his words carefully) ...for my actions.
I saw on the calendar that Victor planned to fire you from the company. Why did you lie?

(nervously chuckling) Ah, that calendar... I, uh, I didn't know Victor had planned to fire me. I mean, I knew things weren't going great between us, but I didn't think it was that serious. (pauses, collecting his thoughts) To be honest, I was trying to protect my shares in the company. If Victor had fired me, I would have lost a significant portion of my investment. (hesitates, choosing his words carefully) I know it sounds selfish, but I was trying to think of a way to save my shares, and... (pauses again, taking a deep breath) I didn't think about the consequences of my actions. I just wanted to protect myself. (looks down, avoiding eye contact)

DANA.content: do you have any conflict with victor?

(nervously) Ah, yes... I suppose I do. I mean, we've had our differences, but I didn't think it was a big deal. (pauses, taking a deep breath) To be honest, I was really upset when I found out that Victor had blocked me from the promotion. I thought I was the perfect candidate, and I felt like he was just trying to sabotage me. (looks down, fidgeting with hands) I complained to him about it around 8:30 PM, but I don't think it was a huge argument or anything. We just... disagreed, I suppose. (looks up at the detective) But I didn't kill him, I swear. I was just really upset and frustrated.
